description: Header file defining the CordzUpdateTracker class, which tracks counters for Cord update methods using atomic operations. It includes enum definitions for method identifiers, thread-safe counter management, and internal class for atomic counters.

classes.name: CordzUpdateTracker
classes.description: A thread-safe class that tracks counts of various Cord update methods using lossy atomic counters.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the current count for a specified update method.

methods.name: LossyAdd
methods.description: Increments the counter for a specified method by a given amount.

methods.name: LossyAdd (overload)
methods.description: Adds counts from another CordzUpdateTracker instance to this one.
